```{r}
# Load Required Libraries
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(janitor) 
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(corrplot)
library(GGally)
library(car)
```



```{r}
model_q3 <- glm(has_incentive ~ final_price + segment, data = rent_clean, family = "binomial")
model_q3
```

```{r}
table(rent_clean$segment, rent_clean$has_incentive)
```

```{r}
rent_space_data <- rent_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(final_sqft), final_sqft > 0, final_sqft < 10000)

# Model: Price predicted by Sq. Ft. and Segment interaction
# This tells us if 1 sq. ft. is "more expensive" in a Condo vs a House
model_q3_alt <- lm(final_price ~ final_sqft * segment, data = rent_space_data)

summary(model_q3_alt)
```

```{r}
# 1. Standard Diagnostic Plots
plot(model_q3_alt, which = 2)
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(residuals(model_q3_alt))
```

```{r}
# Calculate the Variance Inflation Factor
vif_results <- vif(model_q3_alt)

# Print the results
print(vif_results)
```

```{r}
# Log-Log Model: Handling the non-linear relationship and outliers
model_log <- lm(log(final_price) ~ log(final_sqft) * segment, data = rent_space_data)

# 1. Check the new summary
summary(model_log)

# 2. Re-run the Normality Test
shapiro.test(residuals(model_log))


```

```{r}
# 3. Re-run Diagnostic Plots
par(mfrow=c(2,2)) # View 4 plots at once
plot(model_log)
```


```{r}
vif_results <- vif(model_log)

# Print the results
print(vif_results)
```



```{r}
ggplot(rent_space_data, aes(x = final_sqft, y = final_price, color = segment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(title = "Rent vs. Square Footage by Segment",
       x = "Square Feet",
       y = "Monthly Rent ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# 1. Generate predictions from your new model
rent_space_data$predicted_price <- predict(model_q3_alt, rent_space_data)

# 2. Plot Predicted vs. Actual
ggplot(rent_space_data, aes(x = predicted_price, y = final_price, color = segment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Model Accuracy: Predicted vs. Actual Rent Prices",
       subtitle = "Points closer to the dashed line indicate higher model accuracy",
       x = "Predicted Rent ($)",
       y = "Actual Rent ($)",
       color = "Property Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar)
```



```{r}
# Add residuals to your dataframe
rent_space_data <- rent_space_data %>%
  mutate(residual = final_price - predicted_price)

# Define "Extreme Outliers" as those where actual rent is >$1,000 more than predicted
outliers <- rent_space_data %>% 
  filter(residual > 1000) %>%
  arrange(desc(residual))

# Summary of these outliers
cat("Number of extreme outliers found:", nrow(outliers), "\n")
summary(outliers$final_price)
```
